notes.title: New multiplayer beta build
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Firstly, thanks to all the people who recently bought the game, it means a lot! Next, the multiplayer public beta branch has a new update! here are the changes:

If you are interested in helping me test here's what I currently need to make sure is working properly:
With some friends try and clear each of the dungeons in multiplayer, if you notice any crashes please report it to our discord server or our reddit (find on store page)
Make sure medic shield is blocking bullets properly
Make sure game does not immediately crash upon trying to enter a dungeon.

Anyway thats all I need to know for now, here's the changelog! (most of it)

Added 5 new cosmetics:
2 hats
hat and bow tie
some other stuff

Added 2 new planets to the course charter:
Derelict Duneland (currently unfinished)
Mechanized Mausoleum (1 dungeon finished)

Mechanized Mausoleum:
Exclusive new enemies, boss, and new track for the OST by the one and only Tiernan Brazil!

Classes:
The Engineer now charges people around them
The medic now has a shield that blocks bullets
The medic now heals more

Fixes:
There is now a floating triangle marker labelling "YOU" above your character
Moving between rooms is less finicky
Maybe its in this version (?) im pretty sure you just go into dungeons immediately after interacting
You can press TAB to hide chat
Removed one of the derelict dusthouse dungeons from the shop
changed some wording in the UI
Big fish boss no longer crashes the game (probably)

Thanks for reading, and have fun! If you would like to access the multiplayer beta, just check the beta menu in steam settings and join the multiplayer beta branch (its public!)

notes.title: Multiplayer Devlog
notes.notes:
Hey what's up mercenaries! I've been hard at work bringing new updates for yall for a while now, but coming up I have some epic stuff in store.

[previewyoutube=eY4aEdFSuZk;full][/previewyoutube]

First things first, we have started development of multiplayer! Multiplayer will have it's own dungeons and classes so you cant cheese the main storyline. I'm hoping to have multiplayer be 4 player but for now we've only tested with 2. So far we've been making great progress on it and we hope to start beta testing it soon!

Additionally I'm also hoping to add a level editor into the game where players can make or share their own dungeons (Maybe hubworlds as well), however I haven't started development on this yet, and it wouldn't be until after multiplayer is finished till I do.

Thank you all for reading and if you have any suggestions for the game please join our discord server or post on our community hub. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Cone Flyers Mercenaries Version 2
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LOVr3VjohpI;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everybody! Thank you to everyone who has recently bought Cone Flyers Mercenaries! It is a dream come true to be able to make money off one of my creations.
I have a new update in store for you lovely cones! This update adds quite a few new and interesting features! I hope you all enjoy!

changelog:

Tweaks + Fixes:
-Default game volume is now 50%
-Made a platforming room in frigid frostways slightly easier
-Made the 2nd room in Soaked Spikes slightly easier
-a_coneish_one logo is now consistent with our other products
-Added more detail to the cone homeworld
-Added percent completion to the main menu
-Added more detail to the geometry in the meteor belt
-Fixed the pit boss not pausing when under the map
-Made space flying sections slightly faster if you've previously travelled to the planet
-Cone regaining jump calculation is now more precise
-Fixed down bind not working for cancelling dashes
-Fixed scrupulous cone reappearing after leaving milksop 1

-Fixed Cancel button in the ship briefly teleporting you into space for no reason

notes.title: Version 1.1.0

Hello cones! And by cones I mean the two people that bought this game, I am excited to bring you all a new update! Peep the changelog:

-Added a cosmetic hat rack outside Cone Flyers Inc and The Life Engine
-Added endless mode
-Playing endless mode earns you cash for the main game!
-Playing through the main game earns you weapons and upgrades for endless mode!

Weapon buffs:

-Shotgun now does slightly less knockback to the player
-Charger no longer does knockback to the player
-Flamethrower's damage has been changed to 0.2 to 0.225

Fixes:

-Updated to most recent version of steamworkds SDK

Hope you enjoy.
